entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Brother of Liliana Vess, born in the Caligo Forest; cursed, undead, and later made a lich-general of the Cabal.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker, sister of Josu, whose spark ignited when she fought her undead brother.

entities.name: Lady Ana
entities.description: Person who tasked Liliana with gathering the roots of the Esis Tree and warned her against the strange cure.

entities.name: Esis Tree
entities.description: Tree whose roots were meant to cure Josu; its groves were razed.

entities.name: Caligo Forest
entities.description: Josu's birthplace, later turned into a swampland.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane Liliana reached upon unlocking her spark.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction that made Josu a lich dedicated to Belzenlok.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Entity to whom the lich Josu was dedicated.

entities.name: Kyashatar
entities.description: Dragon whom Josu ritually resurrected during her burial ceremony.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Dragon kept away by wards and unable to intervene.

entities.name: The Traveler
entities.description: Hero who dueled Josu and later destroyed him with Serra's help.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Divine figure who helped the Traveler destroy Josu.

entities.name: Rael
entities.description: Figure of the Church of Serra who prophesied about Josu and reclaimed Caligo.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: Church that reclaimed Caligo and the Dawnvault.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: Ruined manor where Josu held court and where his curse could end.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact Liliana used to break the lich spell.

entities.name: Curse of Vess
entities.description: Name for the paradox of the family failing to stop Josu.

events.summary: Josu is afflicted by a magical illness in battle against his father's enemies.
events.quote: Josu was afflicted by a magical illness in battle against his father's enemies.

events.summary: Liliana uses a stranger's cure on Josu, driving him insane and poisoning him anew.
events.quote: It cured Josu of his affliction, but at the cost of driving him insane and poisoning him anew.

events.summary: Liliana turns his victims into zombies to fight him and unlocks her planeswalker spark, ending up on Innistrad.
events.quote: she unlocked her planeswalker's spark and ended up on Innistrad

events.summary: The undead Josu kills his father; the rest of the family fails to stop him, creating the Curse of Vess.
events.quote: was himself killed instead by the undead Josu

events.summary: The Cabal captures Josu and makes him a lich dedicated to Belzenlok.
events.quote: the Cabal made a lich dedicated to Belzenlok

events.summary: Josu starts a ritual to resurrect Kyashatar; the Traveler duels him and lays her to rest again.
events.quote: the Traveler dueled Josu and laid Kyashatar to rest once again

events.summary: Josu raids the Dawnvault and Caligo Morass; the Traveler destroys him with Serra's help.
events.quote: With divine help from Serra , the Traveler destroyed Josu.

events.summary: The Cabal reconstructs and reanimates the lich Josu.
events.quote: the Cabal soon found a way to both reconstruct and reanimate the lich that was Josu

events.summary: Liliana lures the lich back to Vess Manor and breaks the lich spell with the Chain Veil; Josu tells her she is the real curse.
events.quote: She broke the lich spell with the help of the Chain Veil .

relations.quote: Josu was the brother of Liliana Vess .

relations.note: Made a lich-general for the Cabal.
relations.quote: He was then made a lich-general for the Cabal.

relations.note: Broke the lich spell, ending him.
relations.quote: She broke the lich spell with the help of the Chain Veil .
